items.title: Smulyan interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I was listening to them when I was younger... I definitely was exposed to it and I was open and I was interested in hearing about that music.

ctx.x: Here’s some names I’ll lump together, which probably I shouldn’t, but guys like Pharoh Sanders, Patrick Gilmore —
John Gilmore, thank you. Albert Ayler. Did those people have any impact on you? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -13-
